newsitem.title: USA: Disney in pact with Imagine Television.
newsitem.headline: Disney in pact with Imagine Television.

text.p: Walt Disney Co Monday said it entered into an exclusive, multiyear agreement with Imagine Television to develop and produce a variety of television projects.
Under terms of the agreement, Imagine will develop and produce exclusive television projects, including half-hour comedy series, one-hour dramas, motion pictures for television and miniseries.
Imagine Television is a division of Ron Howard and Brian Grazer's Imagine Entertainment, producers of the box ofice hits "Ransom" and "Apollo 13".
